body:
Talia: Quick kick — we need a short customer highlight for tomorrow's launch post (one ~220w blurb + 20s clip + CTA). Can we do record today?
Marco: I can do a 20min slot this afternoon 3:30-3:50pm PT. Will keep it to 3 prompts: pain, result, one-line quote.
Priya: Legal: require explicit quote + logo usage approval. If customer mentions numbers, ask for a signed approval email. I'll archive to /marketing/legal/releases/launch-blitz.pdf.
Talia: Draft Qs pasted: ```1) What problem did you need to solve? 2) What changed after you used Redwood Inference (any concrete result)? 3) One 15-20 word quote we can surface publicly.```
Marco: Adding note: capture a 5s screen showing the new feature and one metric slide for the clip.
Len: Sales routing: tag SFDC as `Case: LAUNCH-BLITZ-2026` and add a short demo CTA that books a 15-min slot. Route EU clicks to EU queue.
Priya: Also ask the customer to approve the final quote text in a reply email. If they don't approve numbers, we'll swap to qualitative phrasing.
Marco: Uploaded prep doc + two quote variants to Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-blitz/draft.txt. Current numeric quote: "Switched to Redwood and cut tail latency by 4x, saving ~35% on token spend."
Talia: Customer prefers tighter wording: "cut tail latency 4x on our workload, and lowered token spend materially." Can we keep that?
Priya: Keep numbers only if they explicitly sign off. Otherwise change to: "substantially reduced tail latency and token costs."
OpsBot: Calendar event created: Launch Blitz recording 15:30-15:50 PT (Marco, Talia, Customer Rep). Meeting link included.
Marco: Plan: record now, edit clip tonight, ask for approval email immediately after, Priya to confirm and archive, Len to add SFDC rule, publish Tue morning with CTA.
Talia: Recap actions: Marco record + upload assets; Priya collect signed reply; Len configure SFDC routing; Marco drop final links here. Small and fast — thanks :rocket:
